Short title and commencement

ORDINANCE XXIV OF 1982
TRAFFIC OFFENCES
(SPECIAL COURTS) (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1982
ORDINANCE XXIV OF
1982
An Ordinance to
amend the Traffic Offences (Special Courts) Ordinance, 1981
[Gazette of
Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I, 10th October, 1982]
No. F. 17(1)/82-Pub.-The following
Ordinance made by the President is hereby published for general information :-
1. Short title and
commencement.-(1) This Ordinance may be called the Traffic Offences
(Special Courts) (Amendment) Ordinance, 1982. ..
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

sections.shortTitle: Traffic Offences Special Courts Amendment Ordinance 1982
sections.description:
Amendment of section 3, Ordinance XXIX of 1981

ORDINANCE XXIV OF 1982
TRAFFIC OFFENCES
(SPECIAL COURTS) (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1982
ORDINANCE XXIV OF
1982
An Ordinance to
amend the Traffic Offences (Special Courts) Ordinance, 1981
[Gazette of
Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I, 10th October, 1982]
No. F. 17(1)/82-Pub.-The following
Ordinance made by the President is hereby published for general information :-
2. Amendment of section 3,
Ordinance XXIX of 1981.--In the Traffic Offences (Special Courts) Ordinance
1981 (XXXIX of 1981), hereinafter referred to as the said Ordinance, in section
3, after subsection (5), the following new subsection shall be inserted, namely
:-
"(5-A) A Special Court may,
if it thinks fit, try a traffic offence in a summary way in accordance with the
provisions contained in sections 262 to 265 of the Code of Criminal Procedure,
1898 (Act V of 1898).".
